module: Manages the lifecycle of the UI router's route transitions: a single transition at a time, transition session (progress milestones, phase, elapsed time per phase and total, route change resends), validation of the frameworks' acknowledgments and classification of timeouts. The module has no side effects on the router: update() returns events (resendRouteChange or timeout) that router.lua handles. Time is accumulated from dtReal provided by onGuiUpdate (not os.clock).
notes: Two timeout regimes. Flat (Angular/legacy, session.phase == nil): a single Config.Timeout delay (3 s) on elapsedTime; on expiry, the TRANSITION_TIMEOUT hook is emitted once ({type="hard", context}) and update returns {type="timeout", reason="timeout_reached"}. Phased (Vue): phases startup, routeCommit, mountReady, done.

Startup phase: returns {type="resendRouteChange", entry=pendingEntry} every Config.PhaseTimeouts.startupResendInterval seconds, never expiring; the phase ends when routeNavigationStarted is received (totalElapsed is then reset to 0). Following phases: routeCommit and mountReady budgets, then total cap; classifications: route_change_not_completed, route_mounted_not_acknowledged, transition_total_timeout.

An acknowledgment is valid if a transition is active, if transitionId (when provided) matches, and if routeName (when provided) matches the expected name (pending entry, otherwise session name, otherwise target route). Failure reasons: no_active_transition, transition_id_mismatch, route_mismatch (complete returns route_name_mismatch).
The transition identifier is generated in the form "transition_<counter>_<UUID>" (Engine.generateUUID).
Minor inconsistency: the comment of start() announces "@return transitionId, success" whereas the function returns (success, transitionId); router.lua does use the order (success, id).
isTimeoutReached only concerns the flat regime (elapsedTime >= Config.Timeout); in the phased regime elapsedTime is not incremented.

isTransitioning.desc: Indicates whether a transition is in progress.

getTransitionId.desc: Returns the identifier of the active transition.

returns.desc: Identifier or nil if no transition.

getElapsedTime.desc: Elapsed time (seconds) since the start of the flat transition, accumulated from dtReal.

isTimeoutReached.desc: Indicates whether the flat regime delay (Config.Timeout) is reached.

getKind.desc: Returns the transition type (context.kind, "navigate" by default).

getToRoute.desc: Returns the destination route of the active transition.

getFromRoute.desc: Returns the origin route of the active transition.

getTransitionContext.desc: Returns a snapshot of the transition context.

validateAcknowledgement.desc: Validates a framework acknowledgment against the active transition (see notes).

transitionId.desc: Transition identifier returned by the UI (optional).

getSession.desc: Returns the active transition session created by router.lua (routeName, routeData, navigationContext, pendingEntry, skipOnMount, mounted, routeChangeCommitted, expectsMountAck, phase, phaseElapsed, totalElapsed, timeSinceLastEmit, handoffAttempts, progress, milestoneAt, protectionToken...).

markProgress.desc: Records a progress milestone reported by the framework after validation of the acknowledgment.

markCommitted.desc: Marks the session as committed (routeChangeComplete promoted the entry). Validation and promotion are done by the router.

markMounted.desc: Marks the session as mounted (routeMounted acknowledgment handled).

getTimeoutInfo.desc: Timing snapshot for the router's timeout handler; the classification is inferred from the progress milestones if not provided.

update.desc: Advances the timing of the active transition; called by router.onGuiUpdate. Returns nil if there is nothing to report.

canStartTransition.desc: Indicates whether a new transition can start (none in progress).

start.desc: Starts a transition: generates the identifier, records target/origin route and session, switches to transitioning. Fails if a transition is already in progress or without a target route.

returns.desc: Transition identifier, or reason (transition_already_in_progress, no_target_route) on failure.

complete.desc: Ends the transition successfully after validating the identifier and route name, then resets all state.

routeName.desc: Finished route (validated against the expected name).

cancel.desc: Cancels the active transition, clears the state and returns to idle.

returns.desc: true if there was a transition.

reset.desc: Resets the state (tests or recovery): idle status, identifier, time, session. Does not reset kind, toRoute or fromRoute to nil.
